title: Plaid button
description: A pill button in five finishes: near-black or white inside a thin rainbow rim (lime, teal, cyan, periwinkle, pink, yellow), a pale mint wash, a teal-to-blue or cyan-to-periwinkle fill, or a periwinkle outline. Rimmed pills pick up a soft periwinkle glow on hover; the washes shift colour.
notes: the rainbow rim is drawn from chart-4/5, highlight, glow, chart-3 and chart-2
